name: Echoform Trails - Bypass with Tail Decay
description: Validates trails mode allows effect tail to decay naturally when bypassed. Tests bypass behavior with trailing wet signal.

capability_requirements.notes: Tests trails mode: bypass with wet tail decay (requires Bypassed=1.0, Trails=1.0)

has_wet_tail.description: Wet tail should be present despite bypass (trails enabled)

natural_decay.description: Tail should decay naturally (feedback decaying without new input)

early_reflections.description: Early reflections should be strong (feedback active at bypass moment)

late_decay.description: Late tail should be quieter (natural decay)

use_cases: Verify trails mode allows wet tail during bypass
Test natural tail decay without new input
Validate bypass behavior (dry passthrough + wet tail)
Ensure feedback continues decaying when bypassed
pass_criteria: Bypassed with natural wet tail decay, no new input processing
example_failures: Silent output → trails not working, immediate cutoff
Sustained energy → new input being processed (not bypassed)
No decay → feedback not decaying naturally
Dry signal absent → bypass passthrough not working
